title: Epigenome-informed Polymer Modeling Reveals Chromosome Folding Landscapes across Distinct Genetic and Epigenetic Contexts
authors: Bazmi, S., Turco, A., Kumar, S.
abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) genome organization is critical for gene regulation, enabling long-range interactions between genes and distal regulatory elements. Genomic structural variations and epigenetic differences can perturb this organization, contributing to phenotypic variation and tissue-specific gene regulation.
